queries:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT t.tradekind AS tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS cnt
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
shares AS (
  SELECT tradekind, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM counts) AS share
  FROM counts
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares
)
SELECT s.tradekind, s.cnt AS count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS share_minus_avg
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN avg_share a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_share;
SELECT tradekind,
       AVG(acctbal) AS avg_acctbal,
       AVG(acctbal) > (SELECT AVG(acctbal) FROM trader WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL) AS above_overall_avg
FROM trader
GROUP BY tradekind;
SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) AS trader_count, AVG(acctbal) AS avg_acctbal
FROM trader
WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY tradekind;
SELECT t.tradekind,
       COUNT(tr.transreg) AS transaction_count,
       CAST(COUNT(tr.transreg) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactionrecord) AS share,
       1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tradekind) FROM trader) AS avg_share
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tradekind FROM trader) t
LEFT JOIN trader td ON td.tradekind = t.tradekind
LEFT JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.trdref = td.tradereg
GROUP BY t.tradekind;
SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM trader t JOIN transactionrecord r ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind);
